name: UI Review
author: Brett
description: Every UI a build makes comes here for Brett's approval, one section per kind (open registry: Design packs, Whole apps / programs, Screens & pages, Settings interfaces, Dialogs & popups, Menus & toolbars, Banners & cards, Other). Each item carries its app, build, branch and PR, desktop + phone screenshots, notes, a status (waiting, approved, changes asked, rejected), his comment and its history. Views: tree, collapsible grid, grid with sub-grids, gallery and side-by-side compare, all with multi-select and bulk Approve / Ask changes / Reject. Builds submit through review.mjs, POST /api/plugins/ui-review/submit or rebuild-shots --submit; other plugins read the per-branch / per-PR state through the ui-review@1 capability. Design packs (formerly their own plugin) are one section: pick up to 3. Screenshots tab (ui-screenshot@1): ad-hoc pictures (check sessions, live captures, PR before/after, uploads) that never enter the approve / reject queue, saved with axf shot / POST shots / Upload; grid grouped by app, screen, source or day, thumbnails, full-screen viewer with before/after slider, copy link, delete, Send to review.
